title: MVI-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Robustness to Misleading Visual Inputs in LVLMs
reasoning: The benchmark focuses on the perceptual robustness of vision-language models against misleading visual cues (e.g., visual resemblance, occlusion, and illusions). While it includes a standard Ethics Statement regarding data collection and potential biases in generated content, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
